messages:
maria: Quick FYI — the onboarding sampleapp is hitting a weird client-side corking issue when pagination + auth refresh collide. Repro: open 10 pages fast, then force token rotate. https://git.redwood/infer/sampleapp/issues/87 :eyes:

kai: Reproduced locally. app spawns page tasks and auth refresh runs, then all inflight requests block until refresh done, then they all retry at once and we get a quota spike + 429s.

samir: Sounds like classic stampede after a single long auth flow. Do we have `max_concurrent_pages` anywhere in the sample config?

maria: Not right now; sampleapp uses the SDK default which lazily launches pages until the token refresh promise resolves. No guard.

oliver: Minimal mitigation idea: make token refresh return a short-lived noop promise and let inflight pages back off with jitter instead of retrying immediately. Can also set a soft cap on concurrency.

maria: Agree. Also saw this in production for a few customers — their bursty onboarding flows + short token TTLs cause repeated small refreshes.

sdk-oncall: Flagging SDK parity concern: Py SDK debounces token refresh and queues new page factories, but JS SDK doesn't. We should either match behavior or expose a togglable strategy.

kai: PR I started adds `authStrategy: { mode: 'queue' | 'cancel' | 'parallel' }` to JS SDK. Default stays parallel for perf, but `queue` will hold new page creation behind refresh.

samir: `queue` seems safest as default for sampleapp. People expect stable throughput on first-run. Also add circuit-breaker for 429s.

maria: Implementation note: if we queue, we must ensure we don't leak promises when the user cancels the whole session. Need explicit abort signals wired to queued factories.

oliver: I'll throw together a quick patch in sampleapp to demonstrate. Proposed sample changes:
```js
// sampleapp pagination launcher
const limiter = new Semaphore(opts.maxParallel || 6);
for await (const cursor of cursors) {
  await limiter.acquire();
  launcher(cursor).finally(() => limiter.release());
}
```

maria: Nice. Also add jittered exponential backoff on 429 + small randomized delay after token refresh to avoid tight retry storms. Example:
```js
retryDelay = Math.min(100 * 2**attempt + rand(0,50), 2000);
await sleep(retryDelay);
```

dev-bot: Deployed sampleapp/staging v0.4.2 to staging (sha: ab12f3). :rocket:

kai: After deploy, samir and I validated stage: with queue mode and maxParallel=6 the corking disappears and token refreshes still succeed without quota spikes. No 429s in 1k-run smoke test. :thumbsup:

samir: Filed follow-up issues: add abort binding, docs for `authStrategy`, and add a Go SDK parity ticket. https://git.redwood/infer/sampleapp/issues/88, https://git.redwood/infer/sdk/issues/452

maria: Great. Can someone add a tiny note in onboarding guide about setting `maxParallelPages` for first-run imports? New users hit this by accident.

oliver: On it — will add note and example config in `/docs/onboarding.md`.

sdk-oncall: Thanks all — will coordinate a minimal test matrix for JS/Py/Go to ensure consistent defaults across SDKs. :white_check_mark:
